world.description: A realistic hiking game in a misty river valley: six survey stakes, a footbridge and a summit cairn before the light runs out.

river.text: Cold and fast. It will carry you back to the last checkpoint, so use the footbridge. And mind the daylight: you have fifteen minutes.

stakes.text: Follow the trail upstream: the meadow, the birches, the waterfall pool. Cross the footbridge for the hut, the fern gully and the ridge. Then the cairn.

start.text: Morning! The valley is lovely before the mist lifts. Six survey stakes mark the route up to the summit cairn.

params.text: Summit reached. The whole valley lies below you.

waterfall.description: A detailed stepped rock waterfall with broad translucent cascades, a round stone-edged pool, foamy impact water, ripples, and scattered natural rocks, readable from every side.

waterColor.description: Color of the waterfall and pool water

intro.objective: Log the six survey stakes up the valley, then climb to the summit cairn before the daylight is gone.
intro.tagline: A river valley at first light
intro.title: Highland Trail

world.name: Highland Trail

then.text: First light on the trail. Find the six survey stakes, then climb to the summit cairn.
Halfway. Cross the footbridge: the river is too cold to wade.

rules.description: Every stake logged: the summit cairn becomes the goal

then.text: All six stakes logged. Climb to the summit cairn!
The light is fading. Keep moving.
Night caught you on the mountain. Try again at first light.
